tool_args.rationale: All pilot responses are positive and measured at H≤0.48. The H≈20 probe directly tests the predicted sign reversal and constrains the slow component near the H=23.9 forecast target.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows constrain the initial rise but do not reliably identify the slow amplitude and time constant needed to forecast at H=23.9.
Finer sampling would help resolve the early rise but would not directly measure the late reversal.
It does not constrain the slow adaptation or the late response.
